definitions: A set of seats arranged in rows, especially in the front part of a theatre or cinema.
A small, enclosed area or booth where goods are sold or displayed, typically at a market.
Individual compartments for animals in a stable or barn.
A sudden loss of engine power or speed in an aircraft, leading to a drop in altitude.
examples: We had excellent seats in the stalls for the play.
She bought fresh produce from the fruit stalls at the market.
The horses were led back to their stalls after the race.
The pilot managed to recover from the stall.
